descriptionChirho: Daniel (Hebrew דָּנִיֵּאל / דָּנִאֵל, 'God is my judge'), a proper noun referring to several individuals in the Hebrew Bible: (1) a son of David and Abigail (1 Chr 3:1); (2) a priest of the line of Ithamar who returned with Ezra (Ezra 8:2; Neh 10:6); (3) a legendary figure of wisdom mentioned by Ezekiel alongside Noah and Job (Ezek 14:14,20; 28:3); (4) the protagonist of the book of Daniel, a Judean exile in Babylon who served at the royal court and received apocalyptic visions (Dan 1:6-8,9,11,17,19,21; 8:1,15,27; 10:1). All inflectional and prepositional forms (to Daniel, like Daniel, than Daniel) are variants of this single proper noun.
